versions.content: Name {DID}_Struct_DataType Kind Structure Description The elements of this structure data type is a composition of all DcmDspDataElement of the Dcm DspDid. Example: A DID with the 3 data elements uint32 data1, sint8 data2 and sint16 data 3, has a structure definition of struct { uint32 data1, sint8 data2, sint16 data 3}.
